product.name: Send money
product.description: A cross-border remittance service for sending funds from countries including the UK, UAE, US and Canada to India, and from the UAE to the Philippines.

product.name: NRI banking
product.description: A digital service that helps non-resident Indians open and manage NRE and NRO bank accounts in India through the Aspora platform.

product.name: Invest in Gold
product.description: A digital gold service that lets users buy, hold and lease gold through the Aspora platform.
